// -------------------------------------------------------------------- // Dynamic GeoJSON Asset Ingestion // -------------------------------------------------------------------- async function loadDynamicPivotRegistry() { try { // Fetch the compiled GeoJSON generated by your shapefile script const resp = await fetch('data/default_pivots.geojson?t=' + Date.now()); if (!resp.ok) throw new Error("No remote default_pivots.geojson found"); const geojson = await resp.json(); const loadedPivots = []; geojson.features.forEach(feat => { const p = feat.properties; const coords = feat.geometry.coordinates; // [lon, lat] loadedPivots.push({ id: p.id, sn: p.sn || '', status: p.status || 'Imported', z_rel: p.z_rel || 6.5, lat: coords[1], lon: coords[0], design_gpm: p.design_gpm || 800, reg_psi: p.reg_psi || 15, max_elev_diff: p.max_elev_diff || 10, polygon: p.polygon_geometry || null }); }); if (loadedPivots.length > 0) { activePivots = loadedPivots; populatePivotDropdown(); renderPivotMarkers(); console.log(`Loaded ${loadedPivots.length} pivots from shapefile GeoJSON.`); } } catch (err) { console.warn("Using offline fallback pivots. Reason:", err.message); } } window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { initMap(); loadCloudConfig(); populatePivotDropdown(); startGpsTracking(); renderSurveyTable(); setDefaultTimes(); // Load your custom shapefile output dynamically loadDynamicPivotRegistry(); window.addEventListener('online', syncOfflineQueueToGitHub); });
